limitations.title: Plugin and theme overhead
limitations.detail: Plugins and themes typically load their CSS/JS on every page, whether the page uses them or not.

limitations.title: Server-rendered on every request
limitations.detail: Without full-page caching, each visit runs PHP and database queries, which slows down TTFB.

limitations.title: Ongoing security maintenance
limitations.detail: Core, theme and plugin updates are needed regularly to stay secure.

manualRebuild.title: Posts and pages database
manualRebuild.detail: Only crawled pages are recreated. Other posts have to be imported (for example from /wp-json/wp/v2/).

manualRebuild.title: Contact Form 7 submissions
manualRebuild.detail: The form UI is recreated; the submission handler must be wired up manually.
